content.json:
## HoneyLabs Threat Intelligence

Indicators from internet-facing honeypot sensors. Every one is **evidence-backed**: the IP ran an exploit or loader command against a sensor, or the URL was pulled out of a payload those commands fetched. Known research scanners are excluded and indicators expire as activity stops.

`ConfidenceScore` grades the evidence behind each indicator (90 = 100+ observed attacks, 60 = a single sighting), so you can pick an alerting threshold instead of muting the feed. `Tags` carry the source network (`asn:ASxxxx`), origin (`country:XX`) and the indicator kind.

content.query:
ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(14d)
| summarize LatestIndicatorTime = arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IndicatorId
| where Active == true and ExpirationDateTime > now()
| where SourceSystem startswith 'HoneyLabs'
| summarize Indicators = dcount(IndicatorId), LastReceived = max(LatestIndicatorTime)
| extend Status = iff(isempty(LastReceived), 'No HoneyLabs indicators yet: check the TAXII connector', 'Connected')
| project Status, Indicators, LastReceived
content.title: Connection

content.query:
ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(14d)
| summarize LatestIndicatorTime = arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IndicatorId
| where Active == true and ExpirationDateTime > now()
| where SourceSystem startswith 'HoneyLabs'
| summarize Indicators = dcount(IndicatorId) by bin(LatestIndicatorTime, 1h)
content.title: Indicators received over time

content.json:
### Choosing an alerting threshold

Higher confidence means more observed attacks behind the indicator. A practical starting point is to alert on the top band and watchlist the rest, then widen once you see the real volume in your environment.

content.query:
ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(14d)
| summarize LatestIndicatorTime = arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IndicatorId
| where Active == true and ExpirationDateTime > now()
| where SourceSystem startswith 'HoneyLabs'
| summarize Indicators = count() by ConfidenceScore
| extend Evidence = case(ConfidenceScore >= 90, '100+ observed attacks', ConfidenceScore >= 80, '10-99 observed attacks', ConfidenceScore >= 70, '3-9 observed attacks', '1-2 observed attacks')
| project ConfidenceScore, Evidence, Indicators
| sort by ConfidenceScore desc
content.title: Active indicators by confidence

content.query:
ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(14d)
| summarize LatestIndicatorTime = arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IndicatorId
| where Active == true and ExpirationDateTime > now()
| where SourceSystem startswith 'HoneyLabs'
| extend Kind = case(isnotempty(Url), 'Malware loader/C2 URL', 'Exploiter source IP')
| summarize Indicators = count() by Kind
content.title: What the feed contains

content.json:
### Where the attacks come from

Concentration by network is what makes a blocking decision defensible: a handful of ASNs usually carry a disproportionate share of the traffic.

content.query:
ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(14d)
| summarize LatestIndicatorTime = arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IndicatorId
| where Active == true and ExpirationDateTime > now()
| where SourceSystem startswith 'HoneyLabs'
| mv-expand Tag = todynamic(Tags) to typeof(string)
| where Tag startswith 'asn:'
| extend ASN = replace_string(Tag, 'asn:', '')
| summarize Indicators = count() by ASN
| top 15 by Indicators desc
content.title: Top source networks

content.query:
ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(14d)
| summarize LatestIndicatorTime = arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IndicatorId
| where Active == true and ExpirationDateTime > now()
| where SourceSystem startswith 'HoneyLabs'
| mv-expand Tag = todynamic(Tags) to typeof(string)
| where Tag startswith 'country:'
| extend Country = replace_string(Tag, 'country:', '')
| summarize Indicators = count() by Country
| top 15 by Indicators desc
content.title: Top origin countries

content.json:
### Matches in your environment

Where these indicators line up with your own traffic. An empty panel here is good news. Matches are ordered by confidence so the best-evidenced hits surface first.

content.query:
ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(14d)
| summarize LatestIndicatorTime = arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IndicatorId
| where Active == true and ExpirationDateTime > now()
| where SourceSystem startswith 'HoneyLabs'
| where isnotempty(NetworkIP) or isnotempty(NetworkSourceIP)
| extend TI_ip = iff(isnotempty(NetworkIP), NetworkIP, NetworkSourceIP)
| join kind=innerunique (CommonSecurityLog
    | extend CS_ip = iff(isnotempty(SourceIP), SourceIP, DestinationIP)
    | where isnotempty(CS_ip)) on $left.TI_ip == $right.CS_ip
| summarize Matches = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
content.title: Matches against CommonSecurityLog

content.query:
ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(14d)
| summarize LatestIndicatorTime = arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IndicatorId
| where Active == true and ExpirationDateTime > now()
| where SourceSystem startswith 'HoneyLabs'
| where isnotempty(NetworkIP) or isnotempty(NetworkSourceIP)
| extend TI_ip = iff(isnotempty(NetworkIP), NetworkIP, NetworkSourceIP)
| join kind=innerunique (CommonSecurityLog
    | extend CS_ip = iff(isnotempty(SourceIP), SourceIP, DestinationIP)
    | where isnotempty(CS_ip)) on $left.TI_ip == $right.CS_ip
| summarize Events = count(), Hosts = dcount(DeviceName), Blocked = countif(DeviceAction has_any ('block', 'deny', 'drop')), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by TI_ip, ConfidenceScore, Description
| extend Report = strcat('https://honeylabs.net/lookup/', TI_ip)
| sort by ConfidenceScore desc, Events desc
| take 50
content.title: Matched indicators (highest evidence first)

content.json: Each row links to its full HoneyLabs report: first seen, the exact requests, payloads and CVEs probed. Data from [HoneyLabs](https://honeylabs.net).
